metas.name: Babylon
metas.description: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, it traces the rise and fall of multiple characters during an era of unbridled decadence and depravity in early Hollywood.

metas.name: The Deer Hunter
metas.description: The lives of a group of friends are forever changed by the Vietnam War.

metas.name: Logan
metas.description: In a future where mutants are nearly extinct, an elderly and weary Logan leads a quiet life. But when Laura, a mutant child pursued by scientists, comes to him for help, he must get her to safety.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Far from Home
metas.description: Peter Parker heads to Europe hoping for a normal summer, but elemental attacks and a mysterious new hero pull him back into a dangerous fight he isn't ready to embrace.

metas.name: A Beautiful Mind
metas.description: A mathematical genius, John Nash made an astonishing discovery early in his career and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But Nash soon found himself on a harrowing journey of self-discovery.

metas.name: The Rock
metas.description: An FBI chemical weapons expert, and a former SAS soldier turned political prisoner, must break into Alcatraz prison when a rogue military group, led by a renegade general, take it over and threaten a nerve gas attack on San Franci...

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
metas.description: Devastated Peter takes a Hawaiian vacation in order to deal with the recent break-up with his TV star girlfriend, Sarah. Little does he know, Sarah's traveling to the same resort as her ex - and she's bringing along her new boyfri...

metas.name: Killers of the Flower Moon
metas.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one - until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Aliens
metas.description: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent out to re-establish contact with a terraforming colony but finds herself battling the Alien Queen and her offspring.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A petty thief desperate for work muscles into the world of crime journalism and becomes the star of his own story as he blurs the line between observer and participant.

metas.name: Looper
metas.description: Criminal syndicates use illegal time travel to send targets into the past to be assassinated by hitmen known as Loopers.

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
metas.description: Two Jedi escape a hostile blockade to find allies and come across a young boy who may bring balance to the Force, but the long-dormant Sith resurface to claim their former glory.

metas.name: Contact
metas.description: Dr. Ellie Arroway, after years of searching, finds conclusive radio proof of extraterrestrial intelligence, sending plans for a mysterious machine.

metas.name: Don't Look Up
metas.description: Two low-level astronomers must go on a giant media tour to warn humankind of an approaching comet that will destroy planet Earth.

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
metas.description: In the bleak days of the Cold War, espionage veteran George Smiley is forced from semi-retirement to uncover a Soviet Agent within MI6.

metas.name: Pan's Labyrinth
metas.description: In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

metas.name: Terminator Salvation
metas.description: As the machines prepare for a final attack, John Connor and a mysterious stranger delve into the heart of Skynet and uncover a terrible secret involving the annihilation of mankind.

metas.name: Dead Man's Wire
metas.description: On February 8, 1977, Tony Kiritsis entered the office of Richard Hall, president of the Meridian Mortgage Company, and took him hostage with a sawed-off shotgun wired with a "dead man's wire" from the trigger to Tony's own neck.

metas.name: Little Women
metas.description: In 19th century Massachusetts, the March sisters--Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy--on the threshold of womanhood, go through many ups and downs in life and endeavor to make important decisions about their futures.

metas.name: Idiocracy
metas.description: Corporal Joe Bauers, a decidedly average American, is selected for a top-secret hibernation program but is forgotten and left to awaken to a future so incredibly moronic that he's easily the most intelligent person alive.

metas.name: The Northman
metas.description: A young Viking prince is on a quest to avenge his father's murder.

metas.name: Ready or Not
metas.description: A bride's wedding night takes a sinister turn when her eccentric new in-laws force her to take part in a terrifying game.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An overachieving London police sergeant is transferred to a village where the easygoing officers object to his fervor for regulations, all while a string of grisly murders strikes the town.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: A wildlife officer helps a rookie FBI agent investigate the murder of a young woman on an American Indian reservation in Wyoming.

metas.name: The Hateful Eight
metas.description: In the dead of a Wyoming winter with a blizzard on the way, a bounty hunter and his prisoner find shelter in a remote stagecoach way station inhabited by a collection of nefarious characters.

metas.name: Ballerina
metas.description: An assassin trained in the traditions of the Ruska Roma organization sets out to seek revenge after her father's death.

metas.name: Roofman
metas.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: An arrogant, isolated investment banker is targeted by an enigmatic entertainment company, plunging into an escalating, reality-bending conspiracy orchestrated by his estranged brother to shatter his emotional detachment.

metas.name: Saltburn
metas.description: A student at Oxford University finds himself drawn into the world of a charming and aristocratic classmate, who invites him to his eccentric family's sprawling estate for a summer never to be forgotten.

metas.name: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
metas.description: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain, their homeland, from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description: As his last assignment, a temporal agent is tasked to travel back in time and prevent a bomb attack in New York in 1975. The hunt, however, turns out to be beyond the bounds of possibility.

metas.name: Les Misérables
metas.description: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who, for decades, has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter. The decision changes their lives forever.

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.

metas.name: The Exorcist
metas.description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
metas.description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.

metas.name: Toy Story
metas.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

metas.name: A Christmas Carol
metas.description: Ebenezer Scrooge, a miserly old moneylender, is visited by three Christmas spirits on Christmas Eve. Scrooge embarks on a journey of self-redemption to mend his miserly ways

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A family struggles for survival in a world invaded by blind alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
metas.description: After the Empire overpowers the Rebel Alliance, Luke Skywalker begins training with Jedi Master Yoda, while Darth Vader and bounty hunter Boba Fett pursue his friends across the galaxy.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: Your Name.
metas.description: Two teenagers, a city boy in Tokyo and a girl in rural Japan, mysteriously begin swapping bodies, forging a connection that sends them searching for one another.

metas.name: People We Meet on Vacation
metas.description: Poppy wants to explore the world and Alex prefers to stay home with a good book, but somehow they are the very best of friends. They live far apart, but for a decade they have spent one week of summer vacation together.

metas.name: Superbad
metas.description: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

metas.name: Edge of Tomorrow
metas.description: A man fighting in a war against aliens must relive the same day every time he dies until he can find a way to stop their power source with the help of an elite soldier.

metas.name: Legend
metas.description: Identical twin gangsters Ronald and Reginald Kray terrorize London during the 1960s.

metas.name: A Few Good Men
metas.description: A military lawyer intends to prove that two US Marines charged with murdering a fellow Marine were only following their base commander's orders.

metas.name: Barbie
metas.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: The Greatest Showman
metas.description: Celebrates the birth of show business and tells of a visionary who rose from nothing to create a spectacle that became a worldwide sensation.

metas.name: Avatar
metas.description: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

metas.name: The Secret Agent
metas.description: Amid the political turmoil of Brazil in 1977, a technology expert is forced into hiding and seeks help from the underground resistance as he tries to flee the country with his young son.

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: Doctor Sleep
metas.description: Years following the events of The Shining (1980), a now-adult Dan Torrance must protect a young girl with similar powers from a cult known as The True Knot, who prey on children with powers to remain immortal.

metas.name: Fantastic Mr. Fox
metas.description: An urbane fox cannot resist returning to his farm raiding ways and then must help his community survive the farmers' retaliation.

metas.name: Eternals
metas.description: The saga of the Eternals, a race of immortal beings who lived on Earth and shaped its history and civilizations.

metas.name: The Maze Runner
metas.description: A teen with no memory of the outside world awakens in a gigantic maze guarded by deadly creatures, and plots a daring escape.

metas.name: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
metas.description: A brash, cocky high school senior, tired of skipping school to spend a boring day at home, is determined to enjoy an epic day roaring around his favorite Chicago sites, enlisting his best friend and girlfriend to join him on the a...

metas.name: Collateral
metas.description: A cab driver finds himself the hostage of an engaging contract killer as he makes his rounds from hit to hit during one night in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Fuze
metas.description: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

metas.name: The Pelican Brief
metas.description: A law student uncovers a conspiracy, putting herself and others in danger.

metas.name: Juror #2
metas.description: While serving as a juror in a high-profile murder trial, a family man finds himself struggling with a serious moral dilemma, one he could use to sway the jury verdict and potentially convict or free the wrong killer.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
metas.description: During World War II, Tommy Shelby returns to a bombed Birmingham and becomes involved in secret wartime missions facing new threats as he reckons with his past.

metas.name: Finding Forrester
metas.description: Forrester, the author of a famous book, decides to help Jamal, a 16-year-old student, discover his writing prowess by mentoring him and enrolling him into a prestigious private school.

metas.name: X-Men: First Class
metas.description: In the 1960s, superpowered humans Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr work together to find others like them, but Erik's vengeful pursuit of an ambitious mutant who ruined his life causes a schism to divide them.

metas.name: The Life of Chuck
metas.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: Psycho
metas.description: A secretary on the run for embezzlement takes refuge at a secluded California motel owned by a repressed man and his overbearing mother.

metas.name: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
metas.description: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers embark on an epic quest to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people.

metas.name: Cruel Intentions
metas.description: Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

metas.name: Magnolia
metas.description: An epic mosaic of interrelated characters search for love, forgiveness and meaning in the San Fernando Valley.

metas.name: Captain America: Civil War
metas.description: Political involvement in the Avengers' affairs causes a rift between Captain America and Iron Man.

metas.name: Top Gun
metas.description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds ...

metas.name: Perfect Days
metas.description: Hirayama cleans public toilets in Tokyo, lives his life in simplicity and daily tranquility. Some encounters also lead him to reflect on himself.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: A simple act of kindness always sparks another, even in a frozen, faraway place. When Smeerensburg's new postman, Jesper, befriends toymaker Klaus, their gifts melt an age-old feud and deliver a sleigh full of holiday traditions.

metas.name: Tombstone
metas.description: A successful lawman's plans to retire anonymously in Tombstone, Arizona, are disrupted by the kind of outlaws he was famous for eliminating.

metas.name: The Butterfly Effect
metas.description: A boy suffers blackouts during traumatic events, but in college he finds a way to travel back in time to those moments and alter the course of his life.

metas.name: Sing
metas.description: In a city of humanoid animals, a hustling theater impresario's attempt to save his theater with a singing competition becomes grander than he anticipates even as its finalists find that their lives will never be the same.

metas.name: Prey
metas.description: Naru, a skilled warrior of the Comanche Nation, fights to protect her tribe against one of the first highly-evolved Predators to land on Earth.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: On the way to the biggest race of his life, a hotshot rookie race car gets stranded in a rundown town and learns that winning isn't everything in life.

metas.name: Thor
metas.description: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.

metas.name: Being John Malkovich
metas.description: A puppeteer discovers a portal that leads literally into the head of movie star John Malkovich.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A pair of underachieving cops are sent back to a local high school to blend in and bring down a synthetic drug ring.

metas.name: The Creator
metas.description: Against the backdrop of a war between humans and robots with artificial intelligence, a former soldier finds the robots' secret weapon to end the conflict, an AI in the form of a child.

metas.name: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
metas.description: In 1926, magizoologist Newt Scamander arrives in New York during his worldwide tour to research and rescue magical creatures as something mysterious leaves trails of destruction in the city, threatening to expose the wizarding world.

metas.name: In Time
metas.description: In a future where people stop aging at 25, but are engineered to live only one more year, having the means to buy your way out of the situation is a shot at immortal youth. Will Salas is accused of murder and on the run with a hos...

metas.name: The Social Network
metas.description: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea and by the co-founder who was later squeezed out of the business.

metas.name: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
metas.description: A pair of charismatic seniors take socially awkward Charlie under their wing.

metas.name: Raiders of the Lost Ark
metas.description: In 1936, archaeologist Indiana Jones is tasked by Army Intelligence to help locate a legendary ancient power, the Ark of Covenant, before the Nazis get it first.

metas.name: A Bronx Tale
metas.description: An intense drama about a boy torn between his tough, hard-working father and a violent yet charismatic crime boss.

metas.name: Basic Instinct
metas.description: A violent police detective investigates a brutal murder that might involve a manipulative and seductive novelist.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

metas.name: The Sound of Music
metas.description: A young novice is sent by her convent in 1930s Austria to become a governess to the seven children of a widowed naval officer.

metas.name: The Outsiders
metas.description: In Tulsa, Oklahoma in 1964, the rivalry between two gangs, the poor Greasers and the rich Socs, heats up when one gang member accidentally kills a member of the other.

metas.name: Death on the Nile
metas.description: While on vacation on the Nile, Hercule Poirot must investigate the murder of a young heiress.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
metas.description: As Harry Potter begins his sixth year at Hogwarts, he discovers an old book marked as "the property of the Half-Blood Prince" and begins to learn more about Lord Voldemort's dark past.

metas.name: Clue
metas.description: Six guests are anonymously invited to a strange mansion for dinner, but after their host is killed, they must cooperate with the staff to identify the murderer as the bodies pile up.

metas.name: Mother!
metas.description: A couple's relationship is tested when uninvited guests arrive at their home, disrupting their tranquil existence.
